title: A café visit from start to finish

sections.title: Three ways to order
sections.content: You now know three ways to order. *Kérek* is the everyday one. *Kérnék* and *szeretnék* are softer and more polite. All three take the thing you order with *-t*. For another person use *szeretne* or *kér*, and for something specific, such as the menu or the bill, use *kérem*.

sections.title: The order of a visit
sections.content: A visit goes step by step: greet, ask for the menu, order, ask for more, ask for the bill, pay.

items.english: Good day! I would like the menu.
I would like a cup of coffee.
I would like the bill. I'll pay.

sections.content: Choose by what you order: a thing from the menu is *egy kávét* with *kérek / kérnék / szeretnék*; the menu and the bill are specific, so they get *kérem*.
